lead.question: 同样面对险路、裂缝和水塘，布鲁斯开车的方式与其他人的反应究竟有何不同？
lead.warmup: 这是一篇画面感十足的公路冒险故事。作者和同伴雇布鲁斯开车穿越一片荒原，路面崎岖、巨石遍布，前方还横着一条又长又深的裂缝和一片浅水塘，同伴们一路提心吊胆，布鲁斯却始终若无其事，把车越开越快。读前先想一想：是什么让这两种反应形成如此鲜明的对比？
goals: 掌握 be perturbed / relief / boulder / fissure 等描写险境的词。
学会用 not in the least、no matter what、sooner or later 表程度与让步。
理解现在分词作状语（Glancing at his map…）及 before/when 引导的时间状语。
体会用对比和幽默（cheerfully announced）刻画人物性格的写法。
lead.summary: 课文讲述作者一行乘坐布鲁斯开的车穿越荒原的经历。面对布满巨石、坑洼不平的土路，以及横亘前方的巨大裂缝和一片浅水塘，同伴们提心吊胆，布鲁斯却毫无惧色，始终把车开得飞快。最后车在水塘中央熄了火，他却兴高采烈地宣布发动机没油了。全文以强烈的对比和意外结局，塑造出一个‘不知危险’的司机形象。
lead.tips: 写作诀窍：先渲染危险，再突出人物的淡然，反差能让人物立刻立起来；语法上牢记让步从句 No matter what the conditions were 要用陈述语序，不可用疑问语序倒装。

questions.q: What was the difference between Bruce's behaviour and that of other people?
questions.zh: 布鲁斯的行为方式和其他人有什么区别？
questions.a: Bruce was not in the least perturbed and had no sense of danger at all, while the others were worried and afraid.
questions.aZh: 布鲁斯一点儿也不慌乱，压根儿没有危险感，而其他人则忧心忡忡、担惊受怕。
questions.hint: 首听关注课文第2、5句 “Bruce was not in the least perturbed” 与 “no sense of danger at all”，与同伴的反应形成对比。

questions.q: Why did the travellers try to persuade Bruce to turn back?
questions.zh: 旅行者为什么试图劝说布鲁斯把车开回去？
questions.a: Because the road across the plain was extremely rough—littered with boulders and pitted with holes.
questions.aZh: 因为穿越平原的路极其崎岖——布满巨石，坑坑洼洼。
questions.hint: 见课文第1、2句：“so bad that we tried to get Bruce to drive back” 与 “littered with boulders and pitted with holes”。

questions.q: How did Bruce react to the rough road?
questions.zh: 布鲁斯对糟糕的路况作何反应？
questions.a: He was not in the least perturbed; he simply had no sense of danger at all.
questions.aZh: 他一点儿也不慌乱，他压根儿没有一点儿危险感。
questions.hint: 课文第2、5句 “Bruce was not in the least perturbed” 与 “He simply had no sense of danger at all”。

questions.q: What was Bruce's rule about driving, whatever the conditions were?
questions.zh: 无论路况如何，布鲁斯开车的信条是什么？
questions.a: No matter what the conditions were, he believed that a car should be driven as fast as it could possibly go.
questions.aZh: 他认为不管路面情况如何，车必须以最高速度前进。
questions.hint: 课文第6句 “No matter what the conditions were…as fast as it could possibly go”。

questions.q: What does the last sentence tell us about Bruce's character?
questions.zh: 课文最后一句说明了布鲁斯怎样的性格？
questions.a: When the yellow light flashed angrily, he cheerfully announced there was no oil in the engine, showing he never worried or panicked.
questions.aZh: 黄灯刺眼地亮起时，他竟兴致勃勃地宣布发动机没油了，说明他从不为危险担忧或惊慌。
questions.hint: 课文末句 “Bruce cheerfully announced that there was no oil in the engine!” 及其中的 cheerfully。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我们还未来得及担心后果，车已重新开上了平地。
exercises.a: Before we had time to worry about what might happen, we were back on the plain again.
exercises.note: worry about 担心；before 引导时间状语

exercises.q: 汉译英：尽管路面布满石头，坑坑洼洼，布鲁斯却一点儿也不慌乱。
exercises.a: Even though the road was littered with boulders and pitted with holes, Bruce was not in the least perturbed.
exercises.note: not in the least 丝毫不；be littered with

exercises.q: 改为间接引语：We said to him, “The fissure extends for fifty yards and is two feet wide.”
exercises.a: We informed him that the fissure extended for fifty yards and was two feet wide.
exercises.note: 间接引语中时态要后移

exercises.q: 填空：No matter ____ the conditions were, he believed that a car should be driven as fast as it could ____ go.
exercises.note: no matter what 让步；as fast as possible

exercises.q: 用所给词的正确形式填空：____ (glance) at his map, he informed us that the next village was a mere twenty miles away.
exercises.note: 现在分词作状语，表伴随动作

exercises.q: 用虚拟语气完成句子：We did not notice the leak. If we ____ (notice) it earlier, the car ____ (not stop) in the middle of the pool.
exercises.a: had noticed / would not have stopped
exercises.note: 与过去相反：had done … would have done

exercises.q: 改错：No matter what were the conditions, he believed that a car should be driven as fast as possible.
exercises.a: No matter what the conditions were, he believed that a car should be driven as fast as possible.
exercises.note: 让步从句用陈述语序，不倒装

quiz.q: 布鲁斯对糟糕路况的镇定态度，可以用哪个短语概括？
options: deeply anxious
extremely worried
not in the least perturbed
in a panic
quiz.note: not in the least perturbed 意为‘丝毫不慌乱’。

quiz.q: “littered with boulders and pitted with holes” 描述的是什么？
options: the road across the plain
the village they were heading for
the deep fissure ahead
the shallow pool of water
quiz.note: 该短语描写穿越平原的土路路况。

quiz.q: 面对前方那条又长又深的大裂缝，布鲁斯做了什么？
options: He stopped and refused to go on.
He turned the car back to the village.
He got out to examine it carefully.
He drove at a terrifying speed, keeping the front wheels astride the crack.
quiz.note: 课文：挂慢档，前轮跨在裂缝两边飞驰。

quiz.q: 车在水塘中央为什么会嘎吱一声停住？
options: A stone had ripped a hole in the petrol tank.
There was no oil in the engine.
The water was too deep for the car.
The wheels were stuck in the mud.
quiz.note: 黄灯闪烁，布鲁斯宣布发动机没油了。

quiz.q: 作者写下 “What a relief it was when the boulders suddenly disappeared” 表达什么情绪？
options: Bruce felt afraid of the boulders.
The car had broken down again.
The travellers felt greatly relieved.
They decided to turn back.
quiz.note: relief 表示‘宽慰、如释重负’。

quiz.q: 结尾 “Bruce cheerfully announced that there was no oil in the engine” 体现了布鲁斯什么特点？
options: He was deeply concerned about the engine.
He never panicked, even in serious trouble.
He was anxious and worried about the oil.
He was reassured by the flashing light.
quiz.note: cheerfully 与险境对比，凸显他从不惊慌。
